title: Megurine Luka — A New Member Arrives♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That was a lot of fun today.
Let's meet tomorrow at the same... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good afternoon, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me the other day even though I stopped by without any warning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was my pleasure♪
So, have you found your answer?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have. I've decided to show everyone who I really am. The real Shizuku Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I told my fans the same thing in our livestream. I said that I want them to see me as part of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's wonderful! How did they react?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not everyone was supportive, but most of them left comments saying that they'd cheer me on.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It made me so happy that I keep re-watching the stream to read the comments again and again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great. I'm happy you were able to convey your feelings to them, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Is there any way for us to watch your video?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? Oh, I don't see why not...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Would you mind showing it to us then?
I'm sure Rin would love to see it as well♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You too, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course.
She's been so worried.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think it would be great for her to see your bravery at work too. Would that be all right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're making me blush, but sure.
Well then... How about tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Rin and I will be waiting!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Shizuku♪
And Minori too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hurray! Minori's here too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she is. I asked her to come with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Sorry again, Minori.
I just can't figure this tablet out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
There's no need to apologize.
Everyone has trouble with something!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Besides, coming with you means I get to watch the video with Rin and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I've been looking forward to it♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe! Alright, everyone!
Time to begin our exclusive screening!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hurray♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And... Play!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, look! It's Shizuku!
And look at all the text flying by on the side!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, these must be the comments you mentioned yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. All the fans can send messages and share what they're feeling. Isn't it amazing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, here comes the part where Shizuku makes her announcement.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: My heart is pounding...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad Rin seems to be back to her normal self♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, Rin has been feeling a bit down recently. She's been worrying it was her fault you four were struggling.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She has?
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She was afraid your troubles were due to her comment about you not needing an agency to be idols.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not at all. We were the ones who ultimately made the decision to freelance as an independent group...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I told her as much, so please don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I thought it would be best for her to see for herself instead of just hearing it from me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See, look♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! Shizuku looks so cool!
It's like she's glowing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right?! I've already watched this a bunch of times already, but I can't help but feel amazed every time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean! Let's watch it again♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You told me before that you were sure there'd be those who would support me for who I am now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well... It would seem they were closer than I imagined.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. I'm happy you found them♪
